testcase.name: Scenario: Retain display options when re-adding a staged command: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1274:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain display options when re-adding a staged command ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And 2D Sketches has been staged in the target list ✔ And its Large and Text options are checked ✔ When the user selects the 2D Sketches target row and clicks the remove command button ✔ Then the target list is empty ✔ And 2D Sketches is highlighted in the available commands list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then 2D Sketches appears in the target list ✔ And its Large and Text options are checked ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
